description: Split one PDF into several documents, one per `ranges[]` entry ({ start, end? }, 0-based inclusive; end defaults to start). Multi-output result: base64 mode returns one embedded resource per part; file mode writes indexed siblings ('out.pdf' → 'out-1.pdf', 'out-2.pdf', …). Same page-tree caveats as merge_pdfs (signatures/AcroForm/XMP dropped; boxes kept). Encrypted sources: `password`. Need ONE document from a page subset? Use extract_pages.

dropAnnotations.description: When true, drop ALL annotations. Default keeps self-contained URI link annotations.

encrypt.description: Re-encrypt the output (Standard Security Handler; AES-128 default or AES-256; RC4 never emitted). Applied to every produced range.

permissions.description: Permission flags; each defaults to allowed.

userPassword.description: Open password; omitted/empty = opens without a prompt.

maxOutputSizeBytes.description: Maximum size, in bytes, of each produced PDF. Defaults to 268435456 (256 MiB).

outputMode.description: 'base64' (default) returns the PDF inline; 'file' writes it inside the PDFNATIVE_MCP_OUTPUT_DIR sandbox (SECURITY_VIOLATION when the sandbox is not configured).

outputPath.description: Base output path (file mode). Each PDF is written to an indexed sibling: 'out.pdf' → 'out-1.pdf', 'out-2.pdf', …

password.description: Password (user or owner) of an encrypted source. Never logged or echoed.

pdfBase64.description: Base64-encoded source PDF. Pass `password` for an encrypted source.

ranges.description: Page ranges to extract, one output PDF per range. 0-based, inclusive; `end` defaults to `start` (a single page).

end.description: Last page index (0-based, inclusive). Defaults to start.

name: split_pdf

outputSchema.description: Structured result of a tool producing several PDFs. In base64 mode each PDF is delivered out-of-band as its own embedded `resource` content block (data: URI); `parts[]` here carries only the per-PDF size (and `filePath` in file mode) to stay token-frugal.

title: Split PDF into ranges
